description:
Flydigi BS-series cooler controller

Open-source controller for Flydigi BS-series laptop coolers, featuring smart fan curves, hardware monitoring, RGB control, profiles, and Windows/Linux support.
v3.7.3 正式版已发布。检查更新、下载新版本和读取赞助名单改为优先走官网 thrm.tianli0.top，国内用户无需直连 GitHub；安装程序新增用户协议，并更新了内置的硬件监控组件。
v3.7.3 is now available as a stable release. Update checks, update downloads and the sponsor list now go through the official website thrm.tianli0.top first, so users in mainland China no longer need a direct connection to GitHub. The installer now shows a user agreement, and the built-in hardware monitoring component has been updated.
更新亮点 / Highlights
- 检查更新、下载新版本和读取赞助名单都先通过官网 thrm.tianli0.top 进行，官网暂时不可用时自动改用 GitHub；「查看更新日志」和手动下载会打开官网的更新日志页。
- Update checks, update downloads and the sponsor list now go through the official website thrm.tianli0.top first and fall back to GitHub automatically when the website is unreachable; "View changelog" and manual downloads open the changelog on the official website.
修复与改进 / Fixes and Improvements
- 更新内置的硬件监控组件：可以读取更多 AMD 处理器的核心温度，新增内存温度传感器与更多主板的传感器支持，并修复读取 NVIDIA 显卡时偶发的访问冲突。
- Updated the built-in hardware monitoring component: core temperatures can be read on more AMD processors , memory temperature sensors and more motherboards are supported, and an occasional access violation when reading NVIDIA GPUs is fixed.
